name: Kurogane Ironware
description: A crafted, sculptural store theme for a small family foundry in the hill town of Kanayama, casting iron tea kettles (tetsubin), teapots, trivets and braziers in sand and clay moulds since 1931, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Cast-iron charcoal pages, graphite panels, pale stone text and one muted rust accent; Prata for display, Radio Canada for text. A transparent header lies over a full-bleed, low-light photograph of one hobnailed kettle on a charcoal brazier, a thin line of steam rising, and turns solid charcoal with a hairline as the page scrolls (H8; inner pages start solid); the home page moves in long pauses between two full-bleed photographs and a few calm sections (L1): the foundry idea, a shelf of four kettles, the pour, how a kettle is made (mould, cast, finish), seasoning and care, and the journal. The footer is a colophon (F9), set like the last page of a book: the wordmark, a short statement, the kettle lines as a ruled table (mould, casting, weight and capacity per line), the maker, the foundry and the shop hours. The foundry page (makers, the six-week casting calendar, the kettle lines, the shop and tea room) and Seasoning & care (first use, every day, after use, rust, what iron does not like, sending a kettle), journal, newsletter and contact. The maker, foundry address and hours, the seasoning and care note and the kettle-lines table each live in one synced pattern (the care note shows in short form on the home page, in full on Seasoning & care and beside add-to-cart on every product); each kettle's specifications are product attributes (line, capacity, weight, size, heat, finish), and capacity and weight print under every price (WooCommerce optional: without it the shop shows a static shelf and orders go by email).

summary.en: A quiet, low-light store for a small cast-iron kettle foundry, with kettle specs, a colophon footer and seasoning care.
summary.ja: 小さな鉄瓶の鋳造所のための静かで落ち着いたストア。鉄瓶の仕様、奥付風フッター、育て方とお手入れ付き。
summary.fr: Une boutique calme et sombre pour une petite fonderie de bouilloires en fonte, avec fiches techniques, colophon et entretien.
summary.de: Ein ruhiger, dunkler Shop für eine kleine Gießerei von Gusseisenkesseln, mit Kesseldaten, Kolophon-Fußzeile und Pflegehinweisen.

deviation: Codes: none (H8 + F9 + L1 as planned; combination unused: Mizuha Glass is H8/F3/L1, Asa Linen H8/F8/L13, Undo Ba H8/F7/L12, Hana Kago H8/F4/L8; F9 is used by Koke Garden H4/L8, Neiro Hall H7/L14 and Wagu Mono H3/L13; L1 by Kaori Cosme, Tsuya Lacquer and Mizuha Glass). Neighbours: Kenban Piano School (H6/F11/L9, neutral light) and Kinari Soba (H11/F6/L6, green light) share no code or palette family. Palette as planned (charcoal #1B1C1D, graphite #2B2D2F, pale stone #E4E1DB, muted rust #9A5B3C) with added colours: muted rust is 3.2:1 on charcoal and 2.6:1 on graphite, so it is kept to rules, the colophon diamond, step numerals and focus marks; links, small labels and italic accents use ember #C98E6E (6.2:1 on charcoal, 5.0:1 on graphite); secondary text uses ash #A8A49D (6.9:1 on charcoal, 5.6:1 on graphite); body stone #E4E1DB is 13.1:1 on charcoal and 10.6:1 on graphite; buttons are stone with charcoal text (13.1:1); cast-iron cards #222325 and an iron hairline #3A3C3F were added. H8 differs from Mizuha Glass (pale mist scrim, ink type over backlit glass) by light stone type over a low-light iron photograph with a charcoal scrim from the left, turning solid charcoal; the wordmark is Prata in spaced capitals. F9 differs from Koke Garden, Neiro Hall and Wagu Mono as a centred book colophon on charcoal: label, wordmark, statement, a rust diamond, the synced kettle-lines table (mould, casting, weight, capacity; stacked with labels on phones) and the maker, foundry and shop hours read from the synced foundry card as three centred credits, then a fine print line. L1 differs from Mizuha Glass, Kaori Cosme and Tsuya Lacquer by two dark full-bleed photographs (the kettle on the brazier, the pour) with long pauses on charcoal. Fonts verified against google/fonts OFL.txt: Prata (Regular) and Radio Canada (variable, wght 300-700, wdth 75-100) are OFL-1.1 without a Reserved Font Name, both subset to Latin WOFF2. Product photographs are cropped to 4:5. Added a newsletter page because check-themes requires it; industry cast-iron-kettles and page tag seasoning-and-care are new (The foundry uses the about tag). 18 photographs generated with Grok Build and checked by eye for text, marks and logos.
